messages:
Lena M.: Heads-up — Aperture Systems (acct AP-523) INV-2026-0244 now 67 days overdue. Invoice $64,200, they posted $10k on 2026-03-02, outstanding $54,200. Dunning #4 went out this AM, no reply.

Omar (AcctMgr): I left voicemail for their CFO and chatted with their accounting lead. They say runway crunch after a delayed Series B close. CFO asked if we can accept a 4-month instalment plan.

Shiv (Billing): Standard policy: multi-month requires at least 30% upfront and director guarantee for >90 days. For 4 months we can do 30/25/25/20 if approved. No fee waivers without exec sign-off.

CFO-Aperture: (via Omar) Can you confirm if Redwood will waive the 1.5% monthly late fee for the first month? They really need the waiver to get approval from the board.

Lena M.: We don't waive routine late fees. Exception requires legal + finance exec sign-off. Not approving waiver at this stage. We can offer 30/25/25/20 with standard fees.

Omar (AcctMgr): I can tell them that. They also asked if the first payment can be 14 days after signing to allow wire processing.

Shiv (Billing): 14 days OK if proof of initiation provided within 5 business days of signing. Also require PO number and SOW reference (SOW-23) on remittance.

CollectionsBot: [auto] Dunning #4 sent to ap@aperturesys.com (2026-04-25T08:10:02Z). Delivered.

Omar (AcctMgr): I'll send draft agreement and CC legal@redwood. Draft snippet below — I'll attach via email:

``
Payment Plan Offer - INV-2026-0244
Balance: $54,200
Schedule: 30% ($16,260) due within 14 days of signing (proof of initiation within 5 business days); 25% ($13,550) due 30 days after signing; 25% ($13,550) due 60 days after signing; 20% ($10,840) due 90 days after signing.
Late fees: standard monthly late fees apply (no waiver).
Service: Service remains active pending first payment; auto-suspend re-enabled if first payment not received in 14 days.
Signed agreement and PO required.
``

Lena M.: Approved contingent on signature + first payment initiation proof. If they ask again about waiving first-month fee, escalate to VP Finance.

Legal: [auto] Template payment plan ready. Include clause: "company may request exec waiver; plan remains binding until waiver granted."

CollectionsBot: [auto] Reminder scheduled for 2026-05-09T09:00:00Z.

Omar (AcctMgr): Sending now. Will update thread when they reply.

Lena M.: Thanks — tagging for check-in 2026-05-10. If nothing received by then, escalate to legal and prepare suspension 48 hours after escalation.
